projects.title: AI Cyber Research Assistant
projects.description: Next.js + FastAPI web app for cybersecurity research. Integrated with Apify's Google Search Scraper. Features CVE lookup, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, CISA advisories. Backend orchestrates threat intelligence workflows.

projects.title: YouTube Smart Search
projects.description: FastAPI-powered app for searching YouTube videos and extracting transcripts. Includes bot-detection workarounds, transcript caching, and Bootstrap 5 UI. Deployed on Railway.

projects.title: TimeForge - Unix Timestamp Converter
projects.description: Lightweight utility for converting Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa. FastAPI backend, responsive web UI. Deployed via Railway.

projects.title: Shodan MCP Server
projects.description: Model Context Protocol server for Shodan integration. Exposes 4 tools: lookup_ip, lookup_domain, analyze_risk, search_query. Enables Claude and other MCP clients to query Shodan threat data.

projects.title: CyberInfo Blog Website
projects.description: Next.js 14 portfolio + blog site. Notion database as headless CMS. Covers security automation, SOAR, APIs, detection engineering, DevOps. Professional, mobile-responsive design.

projects.title: SentinelOne SDL Sweeper - Swimlane Turbine
projects.description: Production SOAR automation in Swimlane Turbine. IOC sweeper using SentinelOne SDL v2 LRQ API. Handles TTL expiration, dataset query tagging, and high-volume threat intelligence ingestion.
